author: Yffe
content: Pin (kernel-checked, lean/Thermite/PinIntBottom.lean). §4 claims: 'denote can only make the obligation EASIER (more vacuously true) by bottoming a specCall to True, never harder' and an under-computed fuel₀ 'only adds a TRIVIALLY-TRUE conjunct (the bottomed-out instance), which cannot WEAKEN the conjunction'. Both are FALSE against Denote.lean: only the Prop-position bottom is True; the Int-position bottom is 0 (intVal: 'fuel+1, Expr.specCall' resolves… '| none => 0', catch-all '| _, _, _ => 0'), and the CANONICAL ens shape puts the specCall in Int position ('result as nat == spec_sum(xs)' — the doc's own flagship, quoted in Exec.lean's header). Counterexample (kernel-checks against the shipped spine, axioms standard): registry f(x)=g(x), g(x)=x (real-bodied, complete — the hard gate passes); ens = 'result == f(x)'; env x=1, result=1 (the CORRECT item). denote 2 ens env HOLDS (real content result = x); denote 1 ens env is FALSE (the inner call bottoms, intVal returns 0, the conjunct is 'result = 0'); hence ¬(∀ fuel ≥ 1, req → ens) — the §4 obligation form with an under-computed fuel₀ is FALSE for a correct item, not 'trivially-true-conjunct' padded. Corollary (value-dependent recursion, which the doc concedes makes fuel₀ under-computation unavoidable): for 'result == spec_f(xs)' with unfolding depth |xs| and v ∀-quantified over unbounded seqs, EVERY finite fuel admits an env with |xs| > fuel whose conjunct is false — the exported obligation is FALSE for the canonical recursive item at ANY fuel₀, so the ∀-fuel form is broken for exactly the registry machinery's headline case (no better fuel₀ computation fixes it; the form needs an env-dependent adequacy bound, a stabilization premise, or a Prop-position-only scope). Also false in passing: claim (2) 'an everywhere-non-terminating spec-fn is True by S itself' — in Int position S assigns 0, and the obligation becomes the contentful 'result = 0'. Note: cycle-2's #210 observation ('the ∀-fuel form itself stays sound', 'fuel₀ under-computation verified NOT soundness-bearing') analyzed only the Prop bottom; this finding supersedes that sub-claim.
